scheduling_rules_enforced: The two in-scope examples are 7 nights and 14 days / 13 nights, begin Mon 2027-02-15, and remain inside the requested 2027-02-15 through 2027-03-23 travel window. The preferred Feb 15–18 interval is unresolved; if literal check-in/check-out dates it is only 3 nights, below the 7-night minimum.
Zero Monday-closure conflicts in Beijing: Palace Museum, National Museum, Temple of Heaven interior halls, Summer Palace interior halls, and Mio are NEVER placed on Mondays (Feb 15, Feb 22, Mar 1).

Zero Monday/Tuesday-closure conflicts in Shanghai: Shanghai Museum West, Yu Garden, Da Vittorio, and Sir Elly's (Mon–Tue) are NEVER placed on closed days; Monday Shanghai blocks use Shanghai Museum East (OPEN Mondays, closed Tuesdays) and The Bund (24/7).
Lantern Festival (Saturday 2027-02-20) is highlighted as a special evening opportunity — while steering Yonghe Temple morning visits to a quieter weekday.
No estimated USD/CNY meal or flight totals are fabricated where unverified; verified CNY admission & HSR fares and verified 7-night hotel USD rates are cited transparently.

options.title: Option A: Beijing 7-Night Iconic Heritage & MICHELIN Week (Feb 15–22, 2027)
options.recommended_base: Park Plaza Beijing Wangfujing ($749/7N snapshot) OR base-Beijing Wangfujing ($425/7N snapshot) OR Grand Millennium Beijing ($838/7N snapshot); each quote was captured for Feb 15–22 on 2026-11-26 and must be rechecked live.
options.verified_cost_summary: Hotel (7N, 2 adults): $425–$838 USD (excl. 6%–6.6% VAT). Verified attraction entry subtotal (2 adults, all 10 sights incl. low-season combos): CNY 374 base (~$52 USD; excludes Mutianyu shuttle/cable car & optional special exhibitions). Dining & flights: variable by chosen tier (see published 2-adult set totals on Restaurants page).
options.ideal_for: Travelers wanting a single-base 1-week trip with zero hotel changes, maximum museum/Great Wall coverage, and 3–5 MICHELIN meals.

days.theme: Arrival, Hutongs & Sunset Panorama (Zero Monday Closures)
days.morning: Arrive PEK/PKX -> check into Dongcheng/Chaoyang base (Airport Express CNY 25 + subway CNY 3–5).
days.afternoon: Stroll Nanluoguxiang & quiet side hutongs (open 24/7, free); late-afternoon climb at Jingshan Park (06:30–20:00, CNY 4 for 2) for golden-hour views over Forbidden City.
days.evening: Casual Bib Gourmand dinner at No. 69 Fangzhuanchang Zhajiangmian or splurge welcome dinner at 1* Zijin Mansion (17:30–21:30) / 1* Fu Chun Ju (17:30–21:30) — both verified open Mondays.

days.morning: Tian'anmen Square (free w/ advance passport reservation) -> Forbidden City / Palace Museum (Tue–Sun 08:30–16:30, CNY 80–120 for 2; reserve Feb 9 at 20:00 BJT).
days.afternoon: Exit North Gate -> unwind near Wangfujing / Donghuamen or visit National Museum of China (Tue–Sun 09:00–17:00, free w/ 7-day reservation) if splitting into two museum days.
days.evening: 1* Trb Hutong (verified Mon–Sun 17:30–22:00; Seasonal menu CNY 3,376 + 15% for 2) OR Peking duck across from Park Plaza at MICHELIN Selected 1949 Duck de Chine.

days.morning: Depart 07:30 via direct tourist bus or private car to Mutianyu Great Wall (off-peak 08:00–17:30, base admission CNY 90 for 2; cable car/toboggan extra).
days.afternoon: Hike towers 14–20 (quietest winter scenery), descend via toboggan/cable car, return to central Beijing by ~16:00.
days.evening: Restorative Cantonese dinner in Chaoyang at 1* Cai Yi Xuan (Four Seasons, verified 17:30–22:00; Set for Two CNY 1,688 + 10% + 6%) OR 3* Xin Rong Ji (Xinyuan South Rd, verified 17:30–21:00).

days.theme: Temple of Heaven & Chaoyang CBD Fine Dining
days.morning: Direct Line 5 ride to Temple of Heaven (buy low-season Combo CNY 56 for 2 to enter Hall of Prayer, Tue–Sun 08:00–17:00/18:00).
days.afternoon: National Museum of China (if not visited Day 2; Tue–Sun 09:00–17:00) OR Qianmen historic street.
days.evening: Chaoyang CBD MICHELIN highlight: 3* Chao Shang Chao (CP Center), 1* GIADA Garden (China World, Degustation CNY 3,976 for 2), or ¥¥ value 1* The Beijing Kitchen (SKP) / Poetry·Wine (confirm hours by phone).

days.morning: Arrive 09:00 sharp at Yonghe Temple (daily 09:00–16:30, CNY 50 for 2) on a quieter weekday (avoiding Sat Feb 20 Lantern Festival queues).
days.afternoon: Walk across street to Wudaoying Hutong cafes; MICHELIN lunch at 2* King's Joy (verified Mon–Sun 11:00–22:00, 2 Wudaoying Hutong) -> afternoon stroll at nearby Confucius Temple.
days.evening: Relaxed Bib Gourmand dinner at Bao Du Jin Sheng Long (verified 17:00–21:30) or Lao Chuan Ban (Sichuan).

days.morning: Subway Line 4 to Summer Palace North Gate (06:30–19:00, low-season Combo CNY 100 for 2; allow 3.5–4 hr).
days.afternoon: Return mid-afternoon -> explore 798 Art District (free entry; galleries Tue–Sun 10:00–18:00) in Chaoyang.
days.evening: Lantern Festival night stroll around Qianmen/Shichahai (verify 2027 lantern schedules locally) + dinner at 1* The House of Dynasties (Rosewood, verified 17:30–22:00) or 1* Il Ristorante – Niko Romito (Bvlgari, verified 18:00–22:00).

days.morning: Late morning dim sum or dumplings (Bib Gourmand Bao Yuan in Chaoyang) + TaiKoo Li Sanlitun / shopping.
days.afternoon: Flex slot for any missed museum gallery or tea ceremony; souvenir packing.
days.evening: Farewell dinner: 1* Trb Hutong lunch/dinner, 1* Lei Garden (Jinbao Tower), or 2* Lamdre (confirm hours/booking in advance).

days.morning: Check out of Beijing hotel; Capital Airport Express (CNY 25) to PEK or subway to Beijing South Railway Station for Option B.

options.title: Option B: Beijing (7N) + High-Speed Rail + Shanghai (6N) — 14-Day / 13-Night Dual-City Plan (Feb 15–28, 2027)
options.dates: Check-in Mon 2027-02-15 -> checkout Sun 2027-02-28 (13 nights: Beijing Feb 15–22, 7N; Shanghai Feb 22–28, 6N). This is a separate 14-day proposal; the meaning of the preferred Feb 15–18 interval remains unresolved.
options.recommended_base: Beijing 7N (Option A shortlist) -> Fuxing G-Train -> Shanghai 6N. Exact Shanghai hotel totals for 2027-02-22 -> 2027-02-28 were not captured; do not substitute a different week, a 7-night reference rate, or a prorated total. Re-quote exact dates before booking.
options.verified_cost_summary: Hotel total for all 13 nights: NOT VERIFIED — no exact Shanghai 6-night total for 2027-02-22 -> 2027-02-28 was captured, so no combined total is inferred. One-way Beijing–Shanghai 2nd-class HSR: CNY 1,100–1,340 for 2 adults (official source). Published attraction admission references: Beijing CNY 374 + Shanghai CNY 424 for 2; excludes unpriced Mutianyu cable-car/toboggan add-ons and any special exhibitions.
options.ideal_for: Couples choosing the full 14-day / 13-night two-city example: seven nights in Beijing and six in Shanghai. Exact Shanghai hotel rates for the six-night stay and hotel-to-venue route times remain unverified.

days.theme: Full Beijing Week (Same Zero-Conflict Core as Option A)
days.morning: Complete Forbidden City, Tian'anmen, Temple of Heaven, Mutianyu Great Wall, Yonghe Temple, Summer Palace, 798 Art District, and Beijing Lantern Festival (Sat Feb 20).
days.afternoon: Enjoy Beijing's 33-star MICHELIN landscape across Dongcheng & Chaoyang (e.g., 3* Xin Rong Ji, 2* King's Joy, 1* Cai Yi Xuan, 1* Trb Hutong, 1* Fu Chun Ju).
days.evening: Pack Sunday night for smooth Monday morning high-speed rail departure.

days.theme: Fuxing Bullet Train Beijing -> Shanghai + Bund Lights (Zero Monday Closures!)
days.morning: Depart Beijing South Railway Station on Fuxing G-train (~08:00–09:00; 4.5–5.5 hr; CNY 550–670/pp 2nd class; book 15 days ahead on 12306.cn).
days.afternoon: Arrive Shanghai Hongqiao -> direct Metro Line 2 to People's Square / Huangpu hotel! Afternoon visit to Shanghai Museum East (Pudong, Line 2 — OPEN MONDAYS 10:00–18:00, free permanent galleries + Met Museum 'Jewelry: The Body Transformed' special exhibition running Nov 2026–May 2027!).
days.evening: Sunset walk on The Bund (winter lights 17:00–21:00 sharp, free) -> dinner at 2* Fu He Hui (verified Mon–Sun 17:30–21:00) or Bib Gourmand Rongjia Yellow Croaker Noodles (confirm hours).

days.theme: People's Square Museum, Yu Garden & Bund Michelin Dining
days.morning: Shanghai Museum on People's Square (West, Tue–Sun 09:00–17:00, free; across from Radisson Blu).
days.afternoon: Metro Line 10 to Yu Garden (Tue–Sun 09:00–16:30, off-season CNY 60 for 2) + Yuyuan Bazaar Nine-Turn Bridge & xiaolongbao snacks.
days.evening: Bund dining: 2* Da Vittorio (BFC, verified Tue–Sun 18:00–21:30), 2* Imperial Treasure (Yi Feng Galleria), or 1* Yi Long Court (Peninsula Shanghai, Chef's Tasting CNY 1,976 + 16.6% for 2).

days.theme: Former French Concession, Canton 8 Value 2-Star & Peninsula Skyline
days.morning: Walk Former French Concession tree-lined streets (Wukang Rd, Anfu Rd, Sinan Mansions); coffee & local breakfast.
days.afternoon: Book lunch at famous ¥¥ 2* Canton 8 (Huangpu) OR Peninsula 1* Yi Long Court Dim Sum Lunch Set (CNY 596 base / CNY 694.94 all-in for 2 — incredible Michelin lunch value!).
days.evening: Evening fine dining with Bund terrace views at MICHELIN Selected Sir Elly's (Peninsula 13F, verified Wed–Sun 18:00–22:30; 5-Course CNY 2,576 + 16.6% for 2).

days.theme: Huangpu CNY 2 Ferry, Pudong Lujiazui & Shanghai Tower (Weather-Flex Day)
days.morning: Take the CNY 2 public Huangpu River Ferry from East Jinling Rd to Dongchang Rd (CNY 4 round-trip for 2) into Lujiazui.
days.afternoon: Ascend Shanghai Tower 118F Observatory (CNY 360 for 2; pick clearest day of Days 10–13!) + riverside promenade walk.
days.evening: Highlight culinary splurge: Shanghai's sole 3* Taian Table (Changning; reserve weeks ahead via sh.taian-table.cn) OR 2* The House of Rong (I.M. Pei mansion, Jing'an).

days.theme: Jing'an Temple, Bib Gourmand Noodle Crawl & Optional Yuyuan Night Tour
days.morning: Jing'an district exploration + Bib Gourmand lunch at Lao Di Fang Mian Guan (107 Sinan Rd) or Rongjia Yellow Croaker Noodles (688 W Nanjing Rd).
days.afternoon: Xintiandi shikumen architecture, shopping, or optional afternoon tea.
days.evening: Optional Yu Garden Night Tour (verified winter/spring Fri–Sun 18:00–21:20, CNY 300–436 for 2) followed by 2* T'ang Court (Langham Xintiandi) or 2* Bao Li Xuan (Bvlgari).

days.theme: Flex Culture, Last-Minute Shopping & Farewell Dinner
days.morning: Revisit favorite neighborhood (Rockbund art galleries, Tianzifang, or M50 — verify specific gallery hours before going).
days.afternoon: Packing & souvenir shopping on Nanjing Rd / Xintiandi.
days.evening: Farewell Shanghai celebration: 2* 8 ½ Otto e Mezzo Bombana (Rockbund) or 2* Ji Pin Court (Xuhui).

days.theme: Check out and depart Shanghai (airport / flight time unconfirmed)
days.morning: Check out of the Shanghai hotel and travel to the confirmed departure airport. The airport, flight time, and exact transfer are not provided; verify the current official route and fare after flight details are known.
